title: 2024年12月四级真题 第2套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 As a university student, I've come to realise just how little I know about money. I've come to the brutal realisation that Australia's youth are being done a great disservice by not receiving any consistent financial education.

P2 Diving headfirst into the crash course of starting university, I've quickly tried to get myself up to speed with the financial terms of the modern era to help manage my personal finances.

P3 I've read some financial education books, done some online learning, and have spoken to my nearest and dearest for their pearls of financial wisdom.

P4 There are undoubtedly hundreds of great resources out there for those wishing to improve their financial literacy, but while I was researching, I still kept wishing that I didn't have to play catch-up with the money world. I felt that I was sailing the financial seas with no skills and no life jacket!

P5 However, after talking to my friends who felt the same, I quickly realised that it wasn't my ignorance but the lack of financial education in our schooling system that is leaving high schoolers seriously behind in the modern world of money.

P6 Let's compare a theoretical financial education subject to the standard compulsory English class. On average, English may not be the most popular subject, but it's consistently on the schedule throughout high school, with all students graduating fluent in English.

P7 A financial education subject should do just the same. It shouldn't be just a one-day event but a course integrated throughout the whole of high school that would allow students to gradually expand their financial literacy, and would prevent the need for a 'catch up' phase once we're out on our own after graduation.

P8 In the same way that learning a language or new skills takes time, building financial skills requires practice and years to gradually accumulate bits and pieces of knowledge.

P9 Giving young people the opportunity to become familiar with the world of money would provide them with a great advantage to enter adulthood with confidence and security so that they are able to manage their own money and look after themselves.

questions.q: What has the author come to realise since entering university?
options: He needs a crash course on financial terms.
He is very much lacking in financial literacy.
It requires consistent education to be financially independent.
It is unrealistic to give all Australian youth a financial education.
questions.explain:
【判型】What has the author come to realise直接问一个具体认知结果，不含infer/imply/mainly about等推断或主旨信号词。 46. What has the author come to realise since entering university? A) He needs a crash course on financial terms. B) He is very much lacking in financial literacy. C) It requires consistent education to be financially independent. D) It is unrealistic to give all Australian youth a financial education.

【拆句】What has the author come to realise since entering university?主干是What ... has come to realise，What作realise的宾语；since entering university是时间状语，结构平 铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】As a university student, I've come to realise just how little I know about money. 作为一名大学生，我已经意识到自己对金钱了解得有多么少。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 He needs a crash course on financial terms说作者需要一门速成课，而原文Diving headfirst into the crash course of starting university里的crash course指的是大学开 学这件事本身像速成课，不是金融术语速成课。 B) ✓ 正确 just how little I know about money ↔lacking in financial literacy 预判说我钱的知识少，He is very much lacking in financial literacy里的lacking in financial literacy正是这层意思的标准表达。 C) 答非所问 It requires consistent education to be financially independent谈的是要做到 financially independent的条件，而题干问的是作者意识到什么，P1里realise的宾语并 不是这个条件论。 D) 与原文相反 It is unrealistic to give all Australian youth a financial education说给澳洲青年金融 教育不现实，而原文Australia's youth are being done a great disservice by not receiving any consistent financial education恰恰是在痛心他们没有得到金融教育， 作者立场是该给而不是不现实。 作者在当今货币世界中感觉如何? A) 生存装备严重不足。 B) 对金融文献一无所知。 C) 几乎没有能力向前发展。 D) 被在线资源压得喘不过气来。

questions.q: How did the author feel in today's money world?
options: Badly equipped to survive.
Ignorant of financial literature.
Barely capable of moving ahead.
Overwhelmed by the resources online.
questions.explain:
【判型】How did the author feel直接问感受，是关于感受这个事实的细节题，不含推断信号词。

【拆句】How did the author feel in today's money world?主干How did the author feel，in today's money world是地点/情境状语；结构简单，无陷阱。

【定位】I felt that I was sailing the financial seas with no skills and no life jacket! 我感觉自己正在金融的海洋上航行，却既没有技能也没有救生衣！ 47. How did the author feel in today's money world? A) Badly equipped to survive. B) Ignorant of financial literature. C) Barely capable of moving ahead. D) Overwhelmed by the resources online.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 sailing the financial seas with no skills and no life jacket ↔Badly equipped to survive 预判说作者缺装备处境危险，Badly equipped to survive里badly equipped to survive正是这层意思的标准等值表达。 B) 偷换概念 Ignorant of financial literature里financial literature是金融文献，而原文谈的是 financial literacy/skills，文献和素养是两回事，选项偷换了对象。 C) 程度副词偷换 Barely capable of moving ahead说勉强能前进，原文no skills and no life jacket描绘 的是完全无装备的处境，是不能前进而不是勉强能。 D) 答非所问 Overwhelmed by the resources online说被网络资源压垮，而原文hundreds of great resources out there并没有说作者被压垮，反而是肯定资源很多，作者的负面感受来自 缺装备不是资源多。 作者在与朋友交谈后意识到了什么? A) 他们和他一样热衷于金融事务。 B) 学校教育制度应该为他的困境负责。 C) 高中生对现代金融世界一无所知。 D) 金融课程和必修英语课一样不受欢迎。

questions.q: What did the author realise after talking to his friends?
options: They were as keen as he was on financial matters.
The schooling system was to blame for his trouble.
High schoolers knew nothing about the modern financial world.
Financial courses were as unpopular as compulsory English classes.
questions.explain:
【判型】What did the author realise after talking to his friends问的是一个具体认知结果，没有 infer/imply等信号词。

【拆句】What did the author realise after talking to his friends?主干What did the author realise，after talking to his friends是时间状语；结构平直，无陷阱。

【定位】However, after talking to my friends who felt the same, I quickly realised that it wasn't my ignorance but the lack of financial education in our schooling system that is leaving high schoolers seriously behind in the modern world of money. 然而，和有同感的朋友们聊过之后，我很快意识到，让高中生在现代金钱世界里严重落后 的，不是我的无知，而是我们学校系统里金融教育的缺失。 48. What did the author realise after talking to his friends? A) They were as keen as he was on financial matters. B) The schooling system was to blame for his trouble. C) High schoolers knew nothing about the modern financial world. D) Financial courses were as unpopular as compulsory English classes.

【选项】A) 过度推断 They were as keen as he was on financial matters说朋友们也对金融问题热心，而原 文my friends who felt the same只说朋友们有同感（同样觉得吃力），并没说他们热 心研究金融。 B) ✓ 正确 not...but the lack of financial education in our schooling system ↔ The schooling system was to blame for his trouble 预判说学校系统背锅，The schooling system was to blame for his trouble里was to blame正是这层归因意思。 C) 以偏概全 High schoolers knew nothing about the modern financial world说高中生对金融世 界一无所知，而原文leaving high schoolers seriously behind说的是严重落后不是一 无所知，knew nothing是把落后扩大成零知识。 D) 无中生有 Financial courses were as unpopular as compulsory English classes说金融课和必 修英语一样不受欢迎，原文English may not be the most popular subject只是承认英 语不算最受欢迎，从未说金融课不受欢迎或两者并列，且这点出现在48题区间之外，纯 属无中生有。 作者对金融教育课程的想法是什么? A) 它应该预见学生毕业后的需求。 B) 它应该为学生提供一些基础知识。 C) 它应该像英语教学那样授课。 D) 它应该融入高中教育。

questions.q: What is the author's idea of a financial education course?
options: It should foresee students' needs after graduation.
It should provide students with some basic knowledge.
It should be taught the same way as English is taught.
It should be integrated into high school education.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is the author's idea of a financial education course?问的是作者明确提出的具体主 张，原文应有should句直接对应，不需推断。

【拆句】What is the author's idea of a financial education course?主干What is the author's idea，of短语限定idea的对象，结构平直无陷阱。

【定位】It shouldn't be just a one-day event but a course integrated throughout the whole of high school that would allow students to gradually expand their financial literacy, and would prevent the need for a 'catch up' phase once we're out on our own after graduation. 它不该只是一个一日活动，而该是一门贯穿整个高中阶段的课程，让学生逐步拓展自己的金 融素养，从而避免我们毕业独立生活后还得补课。 49. What is the author's idea of a financial education course? A) It should foresee students' needs after graduation. B) It should provide students with some basic knowledge. C) It should be taught the same way as English is taught. D) It should be integrated into high school education.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 It should foresee students' needs after graduation说该课该预见学生毕业后的需 求，而原文prevent the need for a 'catch up' phase once we're out on our own after graduation说的是避免毕业后补课，不是预见学生需求，foresee needs偷换了 prevent the need这层因果。 B) 以偏概全 It should provide students with some basic knowledge说该课只该提供基础知识， 而原文gradually expand their financial literacy说的是逐步拓展金融素养，且years to gradually accumulate bits and pieces of knowledge强调长期积累，some basic把整 个长期拓展过程缩成基础知识，是范围偷小。 C) 过度推断 It should be taught the same way as English is taught说该课该用和英语一样的教 法，而原文Let's compare a theoretical financial education subject to the standard compulsory English class只是拿英语做类比强调持续性，并没有说要在教法上完全一 样，taught the same way是把类比推过头。 D) ✓ 正确 a course integrated throughout the whole of high school ↔ It should be integrated into high school education 预判说该课应融入高中始终，It should be integrated into high school education里 integrated into high school education正是这层意思的同义表达。 金融素养会给年轻人带来什么? A) 让他们在经济有保障的情况下步入成年。 B) 使他们能够照顾自己而无需担心金钱问题。 C) 使他们在资金管理方面自信而有安全感。 D) 帮助他们熟悉货币世界。

questions.q: What would financial literacy do to young people?
options: Allow them to enter adulthood with financial security.
Enable them to look after themselves without worrying about money.
Render them confident and secure in terms of money management.
Help them become familiar with the world of money.
questions.explain:
【判型】What would financial literacy do to young people问的是金融素养对年轻人的具体作 用，原文应有直接对应句。

【拆句】What would financial literacy do to young people?主干What would financial literacy do，to young people是间接宾语；结构平直无陷阱。 50. What would financial literacy do to young people? A) Allow them to enter adulthood with financial security. B) Enable them to look after themselves without worrying about money. C) Render them confident and secure in terms of money management. D) Help them become familiar with the world of money.

【定位】Giving young people the opportunity to become familiar with the world of money would provide them with a great advantage to enter adulthood with confidence and security so that they are able to manage their own money and look after themselves. 让年轻人有机会熟悉金钱世界，会让他们带着自信和安全感步入成年，并因此能够自己管理 钱财、照顾好自己。

【选项】A) 以偏概全 Allow them to enter adulthood with financial security只保留了security丢掉了 confidence，且把confidence and security压缩为financial security一项，原文是双重 收益而不是只有金融安全。 B) 过度推断 Enable them to look after themselves without worrying about money里without worrying about money是说不必为钱发愁，而原文able to manage their own money只说能管理钱，不等于不必为钱发愁，without worrying是从能管理钱推过头。 C) ✓ 正确 enter adulthood with confidence and security so that they are able to manage their own money ↔Render them confident and secure in terms of money management 预判说在金钱管理上自信且有安全感，Render them confident and secure in terms of money management里confident and secure in terms of money management 正是这层意思最完整的同义替换。 D) 答非所问 Help them become familiar with the world of money说帮他们熟悉金钱世界，而原 文Giving young people the opportunity to become familiar with the world of money里熟悉金钱世界是金融素养这件事的前提条件而不是它带来的后果，题干问的是 financial literacy带来什么，不是它是什么。
